imo-1966-q1.summary: In a contest, 25 students solved at least one of problems $A,B,C$. Among students who did not solve $A$, twice as many solved $B$ as solved $C$. The number who solved only $A$ was one more than the number who solved $A$ together with another problem. Among students who solved exactly one problem, half did not solve $A$. How many solved only $B$?
imo-1966-q1.summaryZh: 一次竞赛有 $A,B,C$ 三道题，25 名学生至少解出一道。未解出 $A$ 的学生中，解出 $B$ 的人数是解出 $C$ 的两倍。只解出 $A$ 的人数比解出 $A$ 且还解出其他题的人数多一人。在恰好解出一道题的学生中，一半没有解出 $A$。求只解出 $B$ 的人数。

methods.title: Translate the Venn regions into integer equations
methods.titleZh: 把维恩图各区域转化为整数方程
steps: Let $a,b,c$ be the numbers who solved only $A$, only $B$, and only $C$. Let $d$ be the number who solved $B$ and $C$ but not $A$. The last condition says $a=b+c$.
Among students who did not solve $A$, the numbers who solved $B$ and $C$ are $b+d$ and $c+d$. Hence $b+d=2(c+d)$, so $d=b-2c$. The number who solved $A$ and at least one other problem is $a-1$.
Partition all 25 students into the four displayed regions and the group that solved $A$ with another problem: $25=a+b+c+d+(a-1)$. Substituting $a=b+c$ and $d=b-2c$ gives $4b+c=26$.

Because $c\ge0$, $b\le6$. Because $d=b-2c\ge0$, we have $c\le b/2$, and therefore $26=4b+c\le9b/2$, so $b\ge6$. Thus $b=6$. Indeed $c=2,d=2,a=8$, and the remaining group has $7$ students, so every condition and the total are satisfied.
stepsZh: 设只解出 $A$、只解出 $B$、只解出 $C$ 的人数分别为 $a,b,c$，解出 $B,C$ 但未解出 $A$ 的人数为 $d$。由最后一个条件，$a=b+c$。
在未解出 $A$ 的学生中，解出 $B$ 与解出 $C$ 的人数分别为 $b+d$ 和 $c+d$。因此 $b+d=2(c+d)$，即 $d=b-2c$。解出 $A$ 且还解出至少一道其他题的人数为 $a-1$。
把 25 人分成上述四个区域以及“解出 $A$ 且还解出其他题”这一组，得到 $25=a+b+c+d+(a-1)$。代入 $a=b+c$、$d=b-2c$，化为 $4b+c=26$。
由 $c\ge0$ 得 $b\le6$；由 $d=b-2c\ge0$ 得 $c\le b/2$，所以 $26=4b+c\le9b/2$，从而 $b\ge6$。故 $b=6$。此时 $c=2,d=2,a=8$，余下那组有 $7$ 人，所有条件与总人数均得到验证。

imo-1966-q2.summary: A triangle has side lengths $a,b,c$ opposite angles $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$. Prove that if $a+b=\tan(\gamma/2)(a\tan\alpha+b\tan\beta)$, then the triangle is isosceles.
imo-1966-q2.summaryZh: 三角形的边长 $a,b,c$ 分别对应角 $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$。证明：若 $a+b=\tan(\gamma/2)(a\tan\alpha+b\tan\beta)$，则该三角形为等腰三角形。

methods.title: Use the sine rule and reduce to a square
methods.titleZh: 使用正弦定理并化为平方项
steps: The displayed condition contains $\tan\alpha$ and $\tan\beta$, so $\cos\alpha\cos\beta\ne0$. By the sine rule, division by the common factor $2R$ changes the hypothesis into $\sin\alpha+\sin\beta=\tan(\gamma/2)(\sin^2\alpha/\cos\alpha+\sin^2\beta/\cos\beta)$.
Since $\alpha+\beta=\pi-\gamma$, the sum-to-product formulas give $\tan(\gamma/2)=\cot((\alpha+\beta)/2)=(\cos\alpha+\cos\beta)/(\sin\alpha+\sin\beta)$.

Substitute this expression and multiply by $(\sin\alpha+\sin\beta)\cos\alpha\cos\beta$. After moving all terms to one side and expanding, the equation becomes $(\sin\alpha\cos\beta-\sin\beta\cos\alpha)^2=0$.
Thus $\sin(\alpha-\beta)=0$. Both angles lie in $(0,\pi)$, so $-\pi<\alpha-\beta<\pi$ and consequently $\alpha=\beta$. Equal angles in a triangle subtend equal sides, hence $a=b$.
stepsZh: 题设出现 $\tan\alpha$ 与 $\tan\beta$，故 $\cos\alpha\cos\beta\ne0$。由正弦定理，把各边除以共同因子 $2R$，题设等价于 $\sin\alpha+\sin\beta=\tan(\gamma/2)(\sin^2\alpha/\cos\alpha+\sin^2\beta/\cos\beta)$。
由于 $\alpha+\beta=\pi-\gamma$，和差化积给出 $\tan(\gamma/2)=\cot((\alpha+\beta)/2)=(\cos\alpha+\cos\beta)/(\sin\alpha+\sin\beta)$。
代入上式，并同乘 $(\sin\alpha+\sin\beta)\cos\alpha\cos\beta$。移项展开后，方程恰好化为 $(\sin\alpha\cos\beta-\sin\beta\cos\alpha)^2=0$。
因此 $\sin(\alpha-\beta)=0$。两个角都在 $(0,\pi)$ 内，所以 $-\pi<\alpha-\beta<\pi$，只能有 $\alpha=\beta$。三角形中等角对等边，故 $a=b$。

imo-1966-q3.summary: Let $O$ be the circumcentre of a regular tetrahedron. Prove that the sum of the distances from its four vertices to $O$ is strictly smaller than the sum of their distances to any other point in space.
imo-1966-q3.summaryZh: 设 $O$ 为正四面体的外接球球心。证明：四个顶点到 $O$ 的距离之和，严格小于它们到空间中任意其他点的距离之和。
imo-1966-q3.answer: If the circumradius is $R$, the minimum sum is $4R$, attained uniquely at $O$.
imo-1966-q3.answerZh: 若外接球半径为 $R$，距离和的最小值为 $4R$，且只在 $O$ 处取得。

methods.title: Centre the vertex vectors and apply Cauchy--Schwarz
methods.titleZh: 以球心为原点并使用柯西不等式
steps: Let the vertices have position vectors $\mathbf v_1,\ldots,\mathbf v_4$ with origin $O$, and let the circumradius be $R$. All $\|\mathbf v_i\|=R$, and all pairwise dot products $\mathbf v_i\cdot\mathbf v_j$ for $i\ne j$ are equal because all six edges have the same length.

Put $\mathbf s=\sum_i\mathbf v_i$. Then $\mathbf s\cdot\mathbf v_i$ has the same value for every $i$, so $\mathbf s$ is perpendicular to $\mathbf v_1-\mathbf v_4$, $\mathbf v_2-\mathbf v_4$, and $\mathbf v_3-\mathbf v_4$. These three edge-direction vectors span space, hence $\mathbf s=\mathbf0$.

For an arbitrary point $P$ with position vector $\mathbf p$, Cauchy--Schwarz gives $R\,PA_i=\|\mathbf v_i\|\,\|\mathbf v_i-\mathbf p\|\ge\mathbf v_i\cdot(\mathbf v_i-\mathbf p)=R^2-\mathbf v_i\cdot\mathbf p$. Summing over the four vertices and using $\sum_i\mathbf v_i=\mathbf0$ yields $R\sum_iPA_i\ge4R^2$, so $\sum_iPA_i\ge4R=\sum_iOA_i$.

Equality would require every vector $\mathbf v_i-\mathbf p$ to be a nonnegative scalar multiple of $\mathbf v_i$. Thus $\mathbf p$ would be parallel to every $\mathbf v_i$. The four vertex vectors are not collinear, so this is possible only when $\mathbf p=\mathbf0$, namely $P=O$. The inequality is therefore strict for every other point.
stepsZh: 以 $O$ 为原点，把四个顶点的位置向量记为 $\mathbf v_1,\ldots,\mathbf v_4$，外接球半径为 $R$。所有 $\|\mathbf v_i\|=R$；又因六条棱等长，任意 $i\ne j$ 的点积 $\mathbf v_i\cdot\mathbf v_j$ 都相等。

令 $\mathbf s=\sum_i\mathbf v_i$。于是 $\mathbf s\cdot\mathbf v_i$ 对每个 $i$ 都取同一值，故 $\mathbf s$ 同时垂直于 $\mathbf v_1-\mathbf v_4$、$\mathbf v_2-\mathbf v_4$、$\mathbf v_3-\mathbf v_4$。这三个棱方向张成整个三维空间，所以 $\mathbf s=\mathbf0$。

任取空间点 $P$，位置向量为 $\mathbf p$。由柯西不等式，$R\,PA_i=\|\mathbf v_i\|\,\|\mathbf v_i-\mathbf p\|\ge\mathbf v_i\cdot(\mathbf v_i-\mathbf p)=R^2-\mathbf v_i\cdot\mathbf p$。对四个顶点求和并使用 $\sum_i\mathbf v_i=\mathbf0$，得 $R\sum_iPA_i\ge4R^2$，即 $\sum_iPA_i\ge4R=\sum_iOA_i$。
若取等号，则每个 $\mathbf v_i-\mathbf p$ 都必须是 $\mathbf v_i$ 的非负倍数，因此 $\mathbf p$ 必须同时平行于所有 $\mathbf v_i$。四个顶点向量不共线，所以只有 $\mathbf p=\mathbf0$，即 $P=O$ 时可能取等号。因此对其他点不等式严格成立。

imo-1966-q4.summary: For every natural number $n$ and every real $x\ne k\pi/2^t$ for $t=0,1,\ldots,n$ and integer $k$, prove $\sum_{j=1}^{n}1/\sin(2^jx)=\cot x-\cot(2^nx)$.
imo-1966-q4.summaryZh: 对任意自然数 $n$ 及满足 $x\ne k\pi/2^t$（$t=0,1,\ldots,n$，$k$ 为整数）的实数 $x$，证明 $\sum_{j=1}^{n}1/\sin(2^jx)=\cot x-\cot(2^nx)$。
imo-1966-q4.answer: The identity holds by telescoping the differences $\cot(2^{j-1}x)-\cot(2^jx)$.
imo-1966-q4.answerZh: 把每一项写成 $\cot(2^{j-1}x)-\cot(2^jx)$ 后望远镜相消即可。

methods.title: Create a telescoping cotangent sum
methods.titleZh: 构造余切函数的望远镜求和
steps: The restriction on $x$ ensures that every sine and cotangent appearing below is defined. Whenever $\sin y\sin2y\ne0$, $\cot y-\cot2y=(\cos y\sin2y-\sin y\cos2y)/(\sin y\sin2y)=\sin y/(\sin y\sin2y)=1/\sin2y$.
Set $y=2^{j-1}x$. Then $1/\sin(2^jx)=\cot(2^{j-1}x)-\cot(2^jx)$ for $j=1,\ldots,n$.

Summing these $n$ identities cancels every intermediate cotangent term and leaves $\sum_{j=1}^{n}1/\sin(2^jx)=\cot x-\cot(2^nx)$. If one includes $0$ among the natural numbers, the case $n=0$ is also true by the empty-sum convention.
stepsZh: 对 $x$ 的限制保证下文所有正弦与余切都有定义。只要 $\sin y\sin2y\ne0$，就有 $\cot y-\cot2y=(\cos y\sin2y-\sin y\cos2y)/(\sin y\sin2y)=\sin y/(\sin y\sin2y)=1/\sin2y$。
把这 $n$ 个恒等式相加，中间的余切项全部抵消，留下 $\sum_{j=1}^{n}1/\sin(2^jx)=\cot x-\cot(2^nx)$。若把 $0$ 也视为自然数，则按空和为零的约定，$n=0$ 时同样成立。

imo-1966-q5.summary: Let $a_1,a_2,a_3,a_4$ be distinct real numbers. Solve the four equations $\sum_{j\ne i}|a_i-a_j|x_j=1$ for $i=1,2,3,4$. This is the intended symmetric system; the official English paper contains two typographical omissions in its displayed second and third equations.
imo-1966-q5.summaryZh: 设 $a_1,a_2,a_3,a_4$ 为互不相同的实数。求解四个方程 $\sum_{j\ne i}|a_i-a_j|x_j=1$（$i=1,2,3,4$）。这里采用题目原意的对称方程组；官方英文试卷所列第二、第三个方程有两处排印遗漏。
imo-1966-q5.answer: Let $m=\min_i a_i$ and $M=\max_i a_i$. Then $x_i=1/(M-m)$ when $a_i\in\{m,M\}$, and $x_i=0$ for the other two indices.
imo-1966-q5.answerZh: 令 $m=\min_i a_i$、$M=\max_i a_i$。当 $a_i\in\{m,M\}$ 时 $x_i=1/(M-m)$；其余两个 $x_i$ 为 $0$。

methods.title: Order the parameters and subtract neighbouring equations
methods.titleZh: 将参数排序并相减相邻方程
steps: Simultaneously permuting the pairs $(a_i,x_i)$ preserves the system. Assume therefore that $a_1<a_2<a_3<a_4$.

Subtract equation 1 from equation 2, equation 2 from equation 3, and equation 3 from equation 4. After resolving the absolute values, the results are $(a_2-a_1)(x_1-x_2-x_3-x_4)=0$, $(a_3-a_2)(x_1+x_2-x_3-x_4)=0$, and $(a_4-a_3)(x_1+x_2+x_3-x_4)=0$.

All three coefficient differences are positive. Subtracting the first resulting relation from the second gives $2x_2=0$; subtracting the second from the third gives $2x_3=0$. The relations then give $x_1=x_4$.

The first original equation becomes $(a_4-a_1)x_4=1$, hence $x_1=x_4=1/(a_4-a_1)$. Substitution verifies every equation because $(|a_i-a_1|+|a_i-a_4|)/(a_4-a_1)=1$. Restoring the original labels yields the stated formula, and the deductions also prove uniqueness.
stepsZh: 同时置换各对 $(a_i,x_i)$ 不改变方程组。因此不妨设 $a_1<a_2<a_3<a_4$。
依次用第二式减第一式、第三式减第二式、第四式减第三式。拆去绝对值后分别得到 $(a_2-a_1)(x_1-x_2-x_3-x_4)=0$、$(a_3-a_2)(x_1+x_2-x_3-x_4)=0$、$(a_4-a_3)(x_1+x_2+x_3-x_4)=0$。
三个系数差都为正。后一个关系减前一个关系，依次得到 $2x_2=0$ 与 $2x_3=0$；再代回可知 $x_1=x_4$。
第一条原方程化为 $(a_4-a_1)x_4=1$，所以 $x_1=x_4=1/(a_4-a_1)$。代入任一方程，其左端为 $(|a_i-a_1|+|a_i-a_4|)/(a_4-a_1)=1$，故解确实成立。恢复原来的指标顺序便得到所述公式，而上述推导同时说明解唯一。

imo-1966-q6.summary: Choose points $K,L,M$ in the interiors of sides $BC,CA,AB$ of triangle $ABC$, respectively. Prove that at least one of triangles $AML,BKM,CLK$ has area at most one quarter of the area of $ABC$.
imo-1966-q6.summaryZh: 在三角形 $ABC$ 的边 $BC,CA,AB$ 内部分别任取点 $K,L,M$。证明三角形 $AML,BKM,CLK$ 中至少有一个的面积不超过 $ABC$ 面积的四分之一。
imo-1966-q6.answer: $\min\{[AML],[BKM],[CLK]\}\le[ABC]/4$, with equality possible when $K,L,M$ are the side midpoints.
imo-1966-q6.answerZh: $\min\{[AML],[BKM],[CLK]\}\le[ABC]/4$；当 $K,L,M$ 均为边中点时可以取等号。

methods.title: Multiply three area ratios
steps: Write $S=[ABC]$ and set $x=AM/AB$, $y=BK/BC$, and $z=CL/CA$. Because the three points are interior, $0<x,y,z<1$.
Using the area formula with the included angle at each vertex gives $[AML]/S=x(1-z)$, $[BKM]/S=y(1-x)$, and $[CLK]/S=z(1-y)$.
Multiply the three ratios: $[AML][BKM][CLK]/S^3=x(1-x)y(1-y)z(1-z)$. For every real $t$, $t(1-t)=1/4-(t-1/2)^2\le1/4$, so the product is at most $1/64$.

If all three small areas were greater than $S/4$, their product would exceed $S^3/64$, contradicting the preceding bound. Hence at least one is at most $S/4$. When the three points are midpoints, $x=y=z=1/2$ and all three areas equal $S/4$, confirming sharpness.
stepsZh: 记 $S=[ABC]$，并令 $x=AM/AB$、$y=BK/BC$、$z=CL/CA$。由于三点都在边的内部，$0<x,y,z<1$。
在三个顶点处分别使用含角面积公式，得到 $[AML]/S=x(1-z)$、$[BKM]/S=y(1-x)$、$[CLK]/S=z(1-y)$。
三个面积比相乘可得 $[AML][BKM][CLK]/S^3=x(1-x)y(1-y)z(1-z)$。对任意实数 $t$，$t(1-t)=1/4-(t-1/2)^2\le1/4$，故该乘积不超过 $1/64$。
若三个小三角形面积都大于 $S/4$，它们的乘积就会大于 $S^3/64$，与上界矛盾。因此至少有一个面积不超过 $S/4$。当三点均为边中点时，$x=y=z=1/2$，三个面积都等于 $S/4$，说明界是精确的。
